Black Electrical Tentacles are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Duoguills, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in I and V Ultrafauna Criticals Up, Ultrafauna Slayer, CriticalUp.ULTRAFAUNA, and Slayer.ULTRAFAUNA augments.

Black Gyrocompasses are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Quos, or for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components for I and V Gravity Attack Plus and AttributeDmg.GRAV augments.

Black Meaty Caecus Livers are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from blue Caecuses, or for 66 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Thermal Attack Plus and AttributeDmg.THERM V augments.

Black Scintimure Tentacles are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Scintimures and Tainted Scintimures, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components of I and V Electric Attack Plus and AttributeDmg.ELEC augments.

Black Stabilizers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Fal-swos with red lights, or for 108 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Melee Draw Surge augments.

Black Vigent Rock Scalps are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Vigents, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Front Attack Plus and PositionDmg.FRONT augments.

Black Yggralith Nuts are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Phanatos, the Netherlord, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in Ranged: TP Gain Up and Custom.WP-R-GP augments.

Black Yggralith Scales are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Phanatos, the Netherlord, or for 78 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Underdog Surge augments.

Big Balaena Water Bags are unique materials in . They can be obtained from blue Balaenas, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Max HP Boost and Boost.HP-MAX augments.
Blatta A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black blatta variant. It can be obtained from Casper, the Unhealthy Eater in Primordia.
Blatta B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green blatta variant. It can be obtained from Prinsipe, the Ravenous in Cauldros.
Blatta C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red blatta variant. It can be obtained from Joker, the Unknowable in Noctilum.
Blatta D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a gold blatta variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from any of the ten gold blatta Tyrants.
Blatta E is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a silver blatta variant. It can be obtained from Vorpall, the Sickle-Fanged in Sylvalum.

Blades Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a pair of Sakuraba Industries Dual Swords. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Natural Artifacts category of the Primordia Collectopedia. The Blades weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Blades * Iron Blades * Carbide Blades * Cermet Blades * Chrome Blades * Chromoly Blades * Cobalt Blades * Original Blades * Titanium Blades * Ceramic Blades * Diamond Blades

Blades II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a pair of Sakuraba Industries Dual Swords. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Fauna category of the Cauldros Collectopedia. The Blades II weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Blades II * Iron Blades II * Carbide Blades II * Cermet Blades II * Chrome Blades II * Chromoly Blades II * Cobalt Blades II * Titanium Blades II * Ceramic Blades II * Diamond Blades II

Bitter Flowers is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.2, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Scirpos. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Beauty and the Beast is a Time Attack Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked after Chapter 8 is completed, and features level 35 versions of the bosses Dagahn and Ryyz. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Blackout is a stat debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Blackout reduces ranged and melee accuracy, the damage dealt by ranged attacks, and evasion.
|-|XR160 Model= Bladeguns are sidearms for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Marnucks or Rail-Gun/M-Laser/B-Bomb/E-Bubble types Qmoevas.
Black Bunnyband is a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can only be obtained by crafting.

Blade Resonance is a mechanic in . Drivers can resonate with Core Crystals to awaken new Blades and increase their possibilities. It is not possible to anticipate what kind of Blades will be created from a Core Crystal. Weapons and arts granted to a Driver depend on the awaken and selected Blades. Drivers can bond with multiple Blades and use three of them during battle. It is possible to switch Blades in order to obtain more combinations allowing more playstyles. Certain special Core Crystals obtained during the story progression or quests always awaken a specific Rare or Legendary Blade. Some of them cannot be used for a long period after obtaining them.

Big Job Preparations (Japanese: , Ōshigoto no Mae ni) is a Main Story Quest in . It is received after speaking to Azurda in the cutscene "Gramps's Misgivings". It is both the first quest received and the first completed, making it a direct or indirect prerequisite for all other quests.
Better Late Than Never (Japanese: , Senkaime no Chikoku, The Thousandth Time Late) is a quest in . It can be received from Gegebi on a balcony outside Bower Lounge in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Big Boost (Japanese: , Banban būsuto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Tora's arts when using a Drill Shield. It inflicts Topple if the first hit connects.

Blade-Sharp Memory (Japanese: , Bureido no Kioku, Blade Memory) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received at the Royal Guard Barracks in the Kingdom of Uraya, after completing the quest Crystal Clear, reaching Chapter 7, awakening Praxis and advancing Praxis's Affinity Chart to level 4.

Blade Eaters are entities similar to Flesh Eaters. They are humans who have been fused with at least part of a Blade's Core Crystal. Blades who have been eaten lack part of their Core Crystals, which usually split in a non-regular shape, as can be seen in Pandoria's or Fan la Norne's crystals. Blade Eaters have a significantly longer lifespan than a regular human. Some Blade Eaters, like Mikhail, have lived for centuries, and are able to use their weapons as if they were Blades. Others, like Gort, end up as failed experiments, suffering numerous mutations that barely keep them alive. Blade Eater technology was pioneered by the Indoline Praetorium as military weaponry. Berserker Mammuts (Japanese: , Bāsāku Mamūto) are enemies in . They are members of the Mammut family, and can be found at level 83-85 in the Chansagh Wastes of the Empire of Mor Ardain. One must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 5 Lacerna Noctis on his affinity chart.
Behemoth Uppercut (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Shield Hammer.

Beraf Industry Ward (Japanese: , Berafe Kōgyō-ku) is a Location in . It is located in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The gate to the plant can be unlocked with the Smùide Plant Key, which can be obtained during the quest We Meet Again.
Bellyfull Canteen (Japanese: , Manpuku Shokudō) is a Location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Blackday Peninsula (Japanese: , Negurode Misaki) is a location in . It is located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, at the furthest point south-east on the map, directly below the Ruins of Judicium. The Dalnes Stone is located here. There are no enemies here.

Benetnash, Elevator #6 (Japanese: , Viron Dai-6 Erebētā) is a landmark in . It is an elevator located on the Lower Level of the World Tree, between Lv. 2, Mizar: Mid Floor and the Megaflote Base. There are no enemies here.
Bipedal Crab Chilis are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tomi Fishmongers in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Black Flower Fields are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cmalaf Artwork in Torigoth. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Dagas.

Bitter Choclits are Dessert Pouch items in They can be purchased at the Shellbrow Wagon in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. One is needed for the quest Tranquility. One is needed for each batch of Choclit Dumplings. They can also be purchased for 180 G from the Pouch Item Emporium in the Land of Challenge after collecting the Nopon Invitation, Pt. 2 on Version 1.5.2 or later.
Black Roast Coffees are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Vargel Tavern in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Perun.

Biblio Paulio is a shop in . It is run by Grapheon and can be found in the Kingdom of Tantal's Theosoir. It specializes in Literature. The Store Deeds can be purchased after buying at least one of each book from the shop, excluding The Flora of Alrest and Gentlemen: A Study.

Blade Bots (Japanese: , Bureido Botto) are enemies in . They are Artificial Blades, and can be found at level 58-60 near the 7th Perimeter Skyport on the World Tree. During the quest Artificial Intelligence, three groups of them must be defeated, with the third group of them being fought at Hardhaigh Dock, Lv. 2 in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Poppi QTπ's level 4 Poppi Ignition and Obrona's level 3 "Electric Mastery".
Blazing Whip (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using Whipswords.
Big Impact (Japanese: , Bigguinpakuto) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Big Bang Edge.

Beautiful Shoots are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular at the Collection Point north of the center of Godsford Isle. In the , Beautiful Shoots can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Belloat Grasses are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular from the Collection Point located near a tree reached by jumping down to the sandy area south of the Fonsett Arch Skip Travel point, or the one found under the tree by Skip Traveling to Rigitte Harbor in Rigitte Waters and by heading up the stairs and to the right, where the Forestry Field Skill can be used. One batch of Belloat Grass is required for the Neon Cookies recipe in Gorg's Patisserie skill.
Benign Butterflies are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the World Tree, in particular at the Collection Point east of Megrez Gateway.
Birial Rhinons (Japanese: , Bīāru Raino) are enemies in . They are members of the Rhinon family, and can be found at level 44-46 at the Toxbloom Spring on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Bebelk Squoods (Japanese: , Bēberuku Suīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Squood family, and can be found at level 48 - 53 by Salvaging at Triedge Isle and the Dalnes Stone on the Central Plain of Temperantia. They can also be found by salvaging at Port Anangham on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain during the quest Bana's Secret Treasure.

Bland Upas (Japanese: , Burando Ūpā) are enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and can be found at level 37 - 46 in the Kingdom of Tantal, at the Lumos Pillar on the Upper Level, or at the Genbu Drifts, in between the Sacred Grove and Yolmunder's Crevasse on the Lower Level. They only appear during snowfall. Two must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 4 Ex Tenebris Lux Blade Special.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Berserk Rings (Japanese: , Beruseruku Ringu) are accessories in and . They extend the duration of the Launch reaction by up to 22% (1.1 seconds). This effect will only apply when the wearer inflicts the reaction. They are the upgraded version of the Soldier Ring accessory. The Tyrant Ring and Goliath Ring accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Beta Scopes (Japanese: , Bētasukōpu) are accessories in and . They reduce an enemy's resistance to Break inflicting Arts used by the wearer. The DLC exclusive Master Scope is the upgraded version of this accessory.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Bio Gauntlets (Japanese: , Baio Gantoretto) are accessories in and . They increase the amount of Special Gauge recharged after cancelling by up to 34%. They are the upgraded version of the Gauntlet accessory. The Nano-Metal Gauntlet and Carbon Gauntlet accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Black Belts (Japanese: , Kuroobi) are accessories in and . They extend the duration of the Topple reaction by up to 22% (1.1 seconds). This effect will only apply when the wearer inflicts the reaction. They are the upgraded version of the White Belt accessory. The Platinum Belt and Rainbow Belt accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

Biban Flamii (Japanese: , Bibān Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family and can be found at level 31-35 on Baldotas Isle and Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago during auroras, when they replace Nyol Flamiis. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Gorg's level 3 Bittersweet Dreams on his affinity chart.

Bipedal Crabs are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, specifically at a Collection Point on the terrace southwest of Eight-Rock Skip's Skip Travel point. One can be used to prepare a ration needed for the quest The Supply Situation.

Bird Chips are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be salvaged in the Indoline Praetorium and at Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular at the Daridan's Stack, Goetuis Wharf #1, Isle of Urchon, and Near Rigitte Harbor Salvage Points.

Black Pomegranates are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular from the two Collection Points near Yurna the Elderwood in the Stomach. In the , Black Pomegranates can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Bion Connectors are Treasure items in . They can be obtained in the Gormott Province by Salvaging at any Gormott Salvage Point. Three are needed to complete Artificial Blade Parts 1.
Bick-O'-Lanterns are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging in the Leftherian Archipelago, particularly at Rigitte Harbor and at Fonsett Village's Messet Point.
Berserker Slash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Greataxe. When used, Zeke swings his Greataxe left, then right.

Beelze Mosquitoes are Insect collectibles in . They can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha, specifically at the northeast Collection Point in the Runo Cave-in. In the , Beelze Mosquitoes can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo. One is needed during Souvenirs from Morytha.
Bledku Lexos (Japanese: , Buredāku Rekusosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 46-50 at the Dalnes Stone on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Beautiful Pearl is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Hamlish in Mercenary HQ, after clearing the quest Vandham's Last Wish. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Info Collector", "Production Mastery" and "Girls' Talk" Field Skills.

Belgio Sovereigns (Japanese: , Berugio Roiyaru) are enemies in . They are Radclyffe-type Sovereigns that can be found at level 52-54 on Highway 8 in the Land of Morytha. Four of them must be defeated to unlock T-elos's level 5 "Heartbreaker" on her affinity chart.

The Benoît Nut is a Key Item in . It can be obtained on the Sauros's Bed in the Gormott Province during the quest Whereabouts Unknown. It can be used to intoxicate Rampaging Sauros and reduce its level from 91 to 36.
Bennett is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at Fonsa Myma Gate in the Kingdom of Uraya. He must be spoken to during Follow Your Passion. Bennett offers no quests or merc missions.
Black Steel Circlers are four Key Items in . They can be obtained in Temperantia during the quest Judicium's Legacy. They must be then delivered to Ismet at the Ardainian Garrison.
Blade Combat is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Blade Affinity is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild for a base price of 800 G.
Blades and Ideas are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Blade Combo Boost (Japanese: , Bureido Konbo Kyōka) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM / Upgrade in and . It increases the extra damage dealt upon progressing a Blade Combo by up to 36%. It also boosts the damage-over-time effects inflicted by certain stage 1 and stage 2 Blade Combos. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. The Carbon Mythra and Pyra-Style Mythra DLC Aux Cores have equivalent effects to this Aux Core's Rank V variant. __TOC__
Bix is an NPC in . Bix is a Phonex who can be found at the Ruins of Fountain Park in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Benjamin the Brain (Japanese: , Sakuryaku no Yūpin) is a Driver boss in . He is fought at level 26 at the Brigands' Hideout in the Gormott Province alongside Menacing Jo and Cartbreaker Grzeg.
Belchett Recycling is a shop in . It can be found at Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is run by Isset and is specialized in Treasure.

Bhianc (Japanese: , Bihanku) is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier and can be found at the Old Industrial District in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is revealed to be a key member of the Brionac organization. Bhianc offers no quests or merc missions.

The Beautiful Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Latest Craze. It enables the purchase of Gorgeous Blusher from the Aquaneze Cosmetics shop at Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Billiard Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Cuisine Researcher. It enables the purchase of Jeweled Billiard Balls from the Hobby Trappers shop at Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Black Nopon Search (Japanese: , Kuroge Nopon Sōsakutai) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Fool's Gold. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Info Collector" and "Expeditionist" Field Skills.

Beautiful Flower is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya after completing the mission Fake Vase. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Dark Mastery", "Assassination" and "Leaping" Field Skills. Completing this mission unlocks the Merc Mission Unreturnable Money.

Benefit Concert is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Indoline Praetorium during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula obtains 2,500 fans. After Chapter 8, it can also be received automatically from the Leftherian Archipelago; if the mission was already unlocked in Indol before that point, it will be transferred to Leftheria. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Wind Mastery" and "Fire Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's attributes. It also increases Ursula's fanbase by a significant amount.
Beqqa is an NPC in . She is a young Urayan who can be found at Seoris Plaza in the Indoline Praetorium during Mellica the Chorister.
Bidibi is an NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found at the Cliffs of Morytha's Inlet. She runs the shop Kinkir Accessories.

Bitlip Drinks are Drink Pouch items in . They can be prepared from a recipe requiring eight Cranberry Bells and two Panda Pansies at Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Fame and Family.

Blade of the Abyss (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Sword Tonfa. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Armored Fist.

Bewitching Divide (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Clear Divide.

Bewilder Slash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Berserker Slash.

Bizarre Soups are Key Items in . They can be made by the Famed Gourmet Chefs run by the Head Fire Dragon and a Fire Dragons Member at the Bellyfull Canteen in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Quest Midnight Feasting upon installing the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass.

Beautiful Bowls are Key Items in . They can be made by the Famed Gourmet Chefs at the Bellyfull Canteen in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Quest Midnight Feasting upon installing the New Quests Pack 1 of the Expansion Pass.

Birds of a Feather (Japanese: , Bāzu obu za Fezā) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from Noganga at Goldmouth Wheelhouse in the Argentum Trade Guild. The quest involves Finch and is available after unlocking Finch's level 5 of the Affinity Chart and after completing her Heart-to-Heart "Bird's-Eye View".
Beneath the Aurora is a DLC Quest in . It is part of the New Quests Pack 2 of the Expansion Pass. It can be received from Len at Rigitte Harbor in Leftheria after starting Chapter 6.
Combat Presence is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Striker at rank 9.
Conflagrant Edge is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Duelist at rank 2.
Combat Boost Meds are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Marnucks.
The Container Key is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from HH100: Hierana at the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros during Mia is Missing!.
The Communication Data is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is acquired during White Lifehold.

Conichien (Japanese: , Konichian) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a Zaruboggan and can be found at Repenta Diner in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles. They have one of the cards needed during Trade Agreement.

Cooking Schooled (Japanese: , Atarashiki Michi, A Fresh Way) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sherry in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. The Basic Mission Search Support Request can be used to locate this mission, but it is not required.
Colubrim Eel Kebabs are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Colubrims.
Conner's Comm Device is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found at Primordia's Sayram Northeast Plain during Welcome Back, Conner.
Conquering Fear is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Hangar of the Administrative District of New Los Angeles between Gwin and Cross during the afternoon.
Colubrim A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black colubrim variant. It can be obtained from Elvira, the Talondrake in Primordia.
Colubrim B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown colubrim variant. It can be obtained from Vortice, the Deific Blast in Cauldros.

Contamination Nation is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.11, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting sixteen Caros. It occurs in the poisonous pool of Noctilum's Vitriol Cesspool. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
The College Blazer is a casual full body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an upgraded version of the School Blazer.

Compulsive Tainted are three Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Tainted group as variants infected by a virus. They are fought at level 24-25 in the Dead Man's Gulch of Noctilum during Dead Men Tell No Tales. They drop no treasure.

Confirming the Legend is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and allows a large amount of Credits and Miranium to be earned quickly. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Control is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Control seizes control of enemies and temporarily turns them into allies. Enemies afflicted with Control stop acting, and they will use Battle Arts on any other enemy that the player targets. When inflicted on players, their battle HUD (Heads-Up Display) vanishes completely, they lose all control of themselves and strafe randomly until the debuff wears off, and they use Battle Arts on their allies. Bosses and Tyrants are immune to Control.

Community is a mechanic in . It is similar to the Development Level mechanic in . Any named NPC the party can speak to will be added to the Community menu under one of three areas: Gormott, Torna, or Auresco. After the completion of certain tasks, NPCs will be added as "supporters" of the party. After obtaining a certain amount of supporters, the community level will increase, to a maximum of 5. Community may also be lost during quests in which an NPC is injured or turns against the party, however this is always regained in a later quest. The Companions' Forum (Japanese: , Meiyū no Katariba) is a location in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder, south of the Companions' Cape. There are no enemies or NPCs here except during one quest, but there is a Key Item (Pororo's Favourite), and Ice Ether deposit, and a Quiet Moment ("All Grown Up"). __TOC__

Companions' Cape (Japanese: , Meiyū no Misaki) is a landmark in . It is located on the Bionis' Shoulder, to the south of Navvir Highland. It is a stronghold for remaining High Entia soldiers who have fled Alcamoth. To the south lies the Companions' Forum, and to the north Navvir Highland. There is a Water Ether deposit here, and no enemies except during one story event.

The Common Ether Pick is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected. It is given by Carranelle in Companions' Cape during Ether Exploitation. She asks the party to try to use it on an Ether Crystal deposit. It allows the party to directly collect gems from an Ether Crystal Deposit.

Congenial Cogs (Japanese: , Yūgi Haguruma) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to the description, it is a pair of stone and metal cogwheels, and it is very old, but the teeth still mesh.

Contemptuous Greymane (Japanese: , Gurō no Guraohāru) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Fogbeast Gogol found at level 78 at Agni's Skygarden Ruins on the Bionis' Shoulder. It is surrounded by three level 67 Ogre Bunnias and three level 68 Ether Bunnias. It is the only source of Meteor Staff and Sun Staff with 2 and 3 empty gem slots, and it guards a Giants' Trove that contains the Martial Artistry and Aggro Up IV (14%) gem. As with other Fogbeasts, dispatching the nearby regular enemies and performing the Yellow Chaos Union Strike attack are both effective means to remove the Riot aura it may inflict. Contemptuous Greymane is the second highest-leveled Unique Monster in after Prosecutor Davru
